name: @ellipsis/cli
description: Ellipsis CLI: drive the Ellipsis cloud from your terminal
//: Not an npm package. The CLI ships only as a Bun-compiled single binary on GitHub Releases, installed by install.sh (see .github/workflows/release.yml). `private` blocks accidental `npm publish`; there is deliberately no `bin` so `npm i -g .` can't install a stale global that shadows the installed binary.
